query: SELECT id AS "id!: String" FROM record_identities INDEXED BY context_scope_facts WHERE kind = 'fact' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.kind') = 'scopeAcknowledgement' AND json_array(json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.session.endpoint.serviceId'), json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.session.endpoint.endpointId'), json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.session.sessionId')) = json_array(?, ?, ?) AND id > ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?
